Maya: Quick heads up 1 I submitted my resignation yesterday. Last day will be 2026-06-11. Need COBRA timing, device return shipping, and a short overlap for handoff.

Liam: Thanks for the notice, Maya. We'll support the handoff. Benefits run through your last day (2026-06-11 23:59 PT). COBRA notice is emailed within ~10 business days and enrollment window is 60 days from that notice.

Maya: Appreciate it. Can we keep a 3-4 hour overlap day the week before for pairing? Ill record the session.

IT: We can extend access for shadowing if requested. Default revocation: Slack/SSO deactivated EOD of last day, building access disabled 09:00 PT next business day. If you have service tokens, list them now. Quick check command: 

```
redwood-cli tokens list --owner maya
```

Maya: Two tokens: telemetry-ingest and nightly-eval-runner. I'll add rotation steps to Confluence. Also planning to drop laptop at HQ mailroom unless pickup is needed.

Ben: Exit interview scheduled for 2026-06-16 14:00 PT. If that doesn't work, propose an alternate. I'll create the offboard task and generate a prepaid shipping label for the laptop.

HR Bot: COBRA notice queued to maya@redwood.com within 10 business days after offboard completion. COBRA enrollment: 60 days from notice. Benefits termination: 2026-06-11 23:59 PT. Reference: https://redwood.in/policies/offboarding.

IT: Marking telemetry-ingest for staggered rotation 2026-06-12 12:00 PT to allow handover. We'll keep keycard active through 2026-06-12 09:00 per request. Please remove any personal data before returning device.

Liam: Thanks, Maya. Please drop a brief prioritized task list here so I can reassign. Also confirm if you want Slack messages exported for knowledge capture.

Maya: Will post a 1-page priority list and upload a 10-min Loom. Yes, please export channel notes for the infra channels. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination. :heart:
